content.en_us:
ZalCraft is a community fork of Zalith Launcher, tuned for modern arm64 Android devices.

This build is arm64-only and requires Android 12 (API 31) or newer.

If you used ZalCraft 1.4.1.x, uninstall it once before installing this version - the application id changed so both can live side by side.

Bug reports and feature requests: https://github.com/Tvallyth/ZalCraft/issues
